FROM DOWNLOAD TO TIMELINE

Three steps.
No file juggling.

You download the installer.
It finds the right models for your GPU.

01

Close Adobe.

Save your work and close Premiere Pro, After Effects and Media Encoder.

02

Run Setup.

Open 4x4Tools-Setup.exe, review the terms and choose picture tools, voice tools, or both. Downloads and installation are automatic.

03

Make your edit.

Find the effects under 4x4Tools. In Premiere, scan voice processors once in Audio Plug-In Manager. AE gets native audio effects.

↓

The setup file is small. NVIDIA's libraries and models need several gigabytes; Setup downloads only your selected tools and GPU model family. You don't pick or unpack extra files.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Less setup.
More clarity.

Do I need NVIDIA Broadcast or a developer account?+

No. The official installer brings the permitted runtime and models for this application. No Broadcast app, NVIDIA developer sign-in, SDK or API key is needed.

Where does my media go?+

Processing runs locally on your installed machine. Setup contacts GitHub to download the required application files. This website has no account form or analytics.

Is this a real-time effect?+

Speed depends on the GPU, frame size, model and stacked effects. Highest Quality is the default; use Faster Preview while editing. Studio Voice HQ is an offline path. No universal real-time guarantee is made.

What should I know about this first release?+

Eye Contact has been user-tested in After Effects. The expanded suite has integration checks, but wider Adobe export and GPU testing remains. Eye Contact in AE supports 8/16 bpc, not 32 bpc. Detail Restore keeps the existing Adobe frame dimensions. Studio Voice may alter timing/phase. The installer is unsigned. Read the validation scope before production work.

I'm a developer. Can I build it myself?+

Yes. Original 4x4Tools source is MIT. Bring your own Adobe/NVIDIA SDKs, models and credentials; none are committed to the repository. Start with the developer setup guide.
